rationale: S-0086-03 proposes a per-cluster Vm-trace deep-dive on the 6 Genuine cells from t0086 at 24 directions on remote CPU. t0088 (recluster_marginals_and_vm_motifs, this brainstorm session's primary commission) covers the same scope with two extensions per researcher directive: (1) re-clusters the 13-cell pool of 6 Genuine + 7 Marginal cells (instead of 6 Genuine cells only), giving a richer mechanistically heterogeneous pool to motif-cluster; (2) runs the per-cluster Vm-trace deep-dive on representative cells at 16 directions (every 22.5 deg) on local CPU, eliminating remote-machine cost. The original S-0086-03 deep-dive scope is fully subsumed by t0088's Phase B; rejecting as covered.
